description:
"Panic City", a city where humans and plates (a virtual species) coexist. Unlike other cities, this city has far more plates than humans. That's why there are so many outrageous things happening here compared to cities where humans live. The main character, Baek-Woon, came to this city to find his father who had lost contact, but he gets into an accident while doing a part-time delivery and gets splashed with a mysterious liquid. When he opens his eyes, his wounds are gone, and he starts to worry about his identity as strange guys start to threaten his life. And for the first time, he faces the problem of coexistence between humans and plates...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
